answer: A durable defense ties each agent to a refundable stake that vests slowly, like pigment seeping layer by layer into shale, with one real deposit locked per identity and forfeited on proven fraud. Honest agents accrue a thick delta of peer-attested history that clones lack; a fake must sink fresh capital and wait out the vesting window for every alias, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount instead of collapsing to near zero.
